Alright... story time:

I was a TI with the US Air Force, and I saw a LOT of stupid shit, like this. My favorite thing came in the form of a letter and a box from a trainee's older brother...

One trainee's brother had already gone through Basic and had been AD for several years, so the trainee thought he knew what to expect. he had gotten the "inside scoop" from his older brother, and dear god did his brother throw him under the bus! I was convinced his brother was lying to him, because every fucking thing the trainee did was wrong, but he was proud of his "accomplishments" as if he had done it perfectly. He was "showing" the other trainees how to do things, and getting them in trouble for doing it wrong, and getting picked on for it. A few weeks in, once he's started to get acclimated, his brother sent him a BIG ol' box of fudge with a card which was FILLED with glitter and sang.

When I went to pass out mail, I saw the pink envelope with pony stickers all over it, and I made the trainee open it right then and there in the dayroom... glitter went fucking EVERYWHERE and he just looked at me like I was going to cave his head in with a bat. I then made him open the box to make sure it wasn't something against the rules, but I already had a pretty good idea what it was... I had seen this before. I made him eat ALL the fudge right there in the dayroom, in front of the rest of the flight, as he sang along with his card. Then, after he was done puking up all that sugar (which he had worked so hard to detox out of his body the past few weeks), I made him clean up the dayroom all by himself.

Moral to the story, if you ever go into the military, keep the information exchange to a MINIMUM! Don't give your address to anyone who doesn't need it... and those that DO get it, tell them not to send anything without your permission, first!
Why? Because you wanted to punish him?

Because the glitter needed to be cleaned up, the box needed to be opened in front of me, and the fudge needed to go away.

I explicitly told all of my trainees, one day one (when they get their addresses), that they're to tell their family NOT to send care packages... At least while they're in Basic. There's simply no need for it. But there was always one or two who couldn't follow directions, or their family didn't care what was asked of them, and they got candy, video games, porn, Pokemon cards, and all kinds of stupid bullshit.

Some of it I could "hold" for several weeks, but good items had to be disposed of... And I couldn't make them throw it directly in the garbage... So I made them eat it until they WANTED to throw it away.
Oh, how I would love to see how that convo with the CSM went down and what that poor Private had to go through thanks to Mom. Glorious!
